01-amalfi-hero.alt: Vintage illustration of Positano's hillside houses, tiled church dome and boats on the Amalfi Coast.

02-beach-weekend.alt: Vintage illustration of a palm-lined Goa beach with gentle waves, coastal rocks and a distant headland.

03-food-tour.alt: Vintage illustration of tomato and basil tagliatelle on a ceramic plate overlooking an Italian coastal village.

04-mountain-escape.alt: Vintage illustration of jagged alpine peaks, a mountain lake and a winding trail through pine-covered hills.

06-new-york.alt: Vintage illustration of Brooklyn Bridge and the Manhattan skyline across New York's East River.

08-rome.alt: Vintage illustration of St Peter's Basilica, a stone bridge and umbrella pines along Rome's River Tiber.

09-dubai.alt: Vintage illustration of the Burj Khalifa and Dubai's skyline reflected in a calm waterfront pool.

10-agra.alt: Vintage illustration of the Taj Mahal in Agra with its minarets, cypress gardens and reflecting pool.

11-naples-itinerary.alt: Vintage illustration of Naples' waterfront promenade, Castel dell'Ovo and Mount Vesuvius across the bay.

12-capri-itinerary.alt: Vintage illustration of Capri's Faraglioni sea stacks, a small boat and a cliffside garden.
